summary: The stakeholder emphasizes the importance of maintaining E-Rate services for rural schools and libraries in Idaho, highlighting the need to continue or improve the service provided to ensure educational access and equity.

claims.requested_action: Continue or improve E-Rate service provision
claims.argument: Idaho public libraries and schools cannot lose high speed connectivity from E-Rate
claims.evidence_quote: Idaho public libraries and schools CANNOT lose high speed connectivity from E-Rate!!! We are a very rural state with low-income households being a prevalent factor. Without the connections provided by our libraries we will become even lower on the education scale than we already are! Please continue or improve the service provided!
